title: Famous artworks
blurb: Recognise the paintings and sculptures everyone references, and know who made them.

items.name: Mona Lisa
items.what: Small portrait with the famous half-smile, behind bulletproof glass.

items.name: The Last Supper
items.what: Mural of Jesus and the apostles at the moment he says one will betray him.

items.name: The Birth of Venus
items.what: Venus arriving on a giant scallop shell.

items.name: The Creation of Adam
items.what: God's finger almost touching Adam's, on the Sistine Chapel ceiling.

items.name: David
items.what: 5-metre marble statue of the biblical hero.

items.name: Girl with a Pearl Earring
items.what: Girl in a blue-and-gold turban glancing over her shoulder.

items.name: The Night Watch
items.what: Huge, dramatic group portrait of a city militia company.

items.name: Las Meninas
items.what: Young princess, her maids and the painter himself, with a puzzling mirror.

groups.name: Impressionism & modern art
groups.intro: From Monet to Picasso: the 1870s to the 1940s.

items.name: Impression, Sunrise
items.what: Hazy harbour at dawn: the painting that gave Impressionism its name.

items.name: Water Lilies
items.what: About 250 paintings of the lily pond in his garden at Giverny.

items.name: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte
items.what: Parisians in the park, painted entirely in tiny dots (pointillism).
items.wiki: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte

items.name: The Starry Night
items.what: Swirling night sky over a village, painted from his asylum window.

items.name: Sunflowers
items.what: Yellow sunflowers in a vase, painted several times.

items.name: The Scream
items.what: Agonised figure under a blood-red sky.

items.name: The Kiss
items.what: Embracing lovers wrapped in gold leaf.

items.name: The Persistence of Memory
items.what: Melting pocket watches in a dreamlike landscape.

items.name: Guernica
items.what: Huge black, white and grey anti-war painting of the bombing of Guernica.

items.name: American Gothic
items.what: Stern farmer with a pitchfork beside his daughter.

items.name: Nighthawks
items.what: Lonely late-night diner seen through a big window.

groups.name: Pop & contemporary
groups.intro: Warhol to Banksy: the art of the auction headlines.

items.name: Campbell's Soup Cans
items.what: 32 canvases of soup cans that defined Pop Art.

items.name: Marilyn Diptych
items.what: Fifty repeated Marilyn Monroe faces, half in colour, half fading to black and white.

items.name: Balloon Dog
items.what: Giant mirror-polished steel balloon animals in candy colours.

items.name: Girl with Balloon
items.what: Stencil of a girl reaching for a red heart balloon; a framed copy shredded itself at auction in 2018.

items.name: Maman
items.what: Giant bronze and steel spider, over 9 m tall.

items.name: Cloud Gate
items.what: Mirror-polished steel sculpture nicknamed 'The Bean'.

groups.name: Asian masterpieces
groups.intro: Works every art lover in Asia knows.

items.name: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
items.what: Woodblock print of a giant clawing wave with Mount Fuji in the distance.

items.name: Along the River During the Qingming Festival
items.what: Five-metre scroll showing daily life in the Song-dynasty capital.
items.wiki: Along the River During the Qingming Festival

items.name: Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains
items.what: Yuan landscape scroll burned and split in two; halves are in Taipei and Hangzhou.

items.name: Yayoi Kusama's pumpkins
items.what: Polka-dotted yellow pumpkins, the Japanese artist's signature motif.
